nom: Thayers Milky Hydrating Face Toner with Snow Mushroom and Hyaluronic Acid

avis.texte: I bought this product because of all of the good reviews. I have tried many different milky toners, and this one is by far the worst on the market. It would leave my skin feeling dry and tight, not glowy and moisturized the way other milky toners do. It also gave me terrible acne and irritated the skin around my eyes, nose, and mouth. If you have sensitive, acne-prone skin, be careful.

I've been using this product daily for well over 2 years now. It's the third step in my skincare routine, right after face wash, when my skin is still wet, and I layer Good Molecule's Hylauronic Acid on top. Between the two, my skin is never dehydrated. An absolute staple in my routine.

This is wonderful for my face. I was having a hard time with dry skin on my face and this brought it back to life, seriously. I apply it at night and in the morning before makeup. My skin has never looked this good. I have acne prone, dry, sensitive skin. This was like a miracle for me.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] It is super hydrating and hydrates the skin really effectively and is really milky and very good to use before I went to work throughout the week on the effectiveness

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is so refreshing! I love milky toners. It is a great fine mist that will be great for summer. It's cooling, refreshing, hydrating for my thirsty dry skin. I sprayed before make up and a few hours later for refresh. No scent I'm detecting and that is a huge plus. I would layer this. Great ingredients and brand. Very impressed with Thayers !

avis.titre: this is one of the best skincare products I have ever used
avis.texte: I am over 50 and I have been serious about skin care for a little over 40 years now and this is one of my favorite products ever. my skin is extremely sensitive, combination skin and it leaves every inch of my skin feeling fresh, hydrated, and incredibly comfortable. I look forward to using this product every morning and night. I love that it doesn't have any type of scent good or bad. I love that it doesn't irritate my skin in any situation. My skin can get extremely sensitized and reactive and I always know I can put this on and it will feel better. I randomly bought this product because I quite like the witch hazel, but I've never used anything like this. I wish this had been around my whole life, it sure would've made my teenage skin a different beast. i've recommended this to a few of my friends and they all love it.
I've only used this once so far and I love it! A little goes a long way. I loved how soft and hydrated it made my skin. Will definitely purchase again

I love toners before my skin care. This one is my favorite i use it twice a day and i lay it on good. It is so gentle . I have eczema on my hand on even lotion burned but this did not burn at all. and it leaves my face so hiydrated NOT OILY i will never be without
This wears beautifully under makeup as someone who has combo skin AND it has helped clear my breakouts!

I was so excited to try this but it is unfortunately not that great -- the texture/consistency is weird because you'd think it would provide this thick, juicy layer when applying but it completely disappears into my skin and it feels like I just applied nothing? Maybe I'm just too dry for it, but it did nothing for me.
Having not used a milky toner before and also now having mature skin it leaves my skin so hydrated.
I needed a new toner and thought this one sounded perfect. I am not sure why but its super sticky on my face— it feels so gross. I love their regular toner and guess I will go back to that one.
I switched to this toner after YEARS of using the CereVe hydrating toner. Thayers, you are MAGNIFICENT!! Extremely hydrating, milky, and refreshing. Will absolutely repurchase.

avis.titre: Why haven't I been using this?
avis.texte: I love it- the Milky texture vs the harsh texture of Toners I have always used is AMAZING and Refreshing
i have really dry skin and this has helped my makeup stick to my face without cracking or separating! i pair it with the cerave daily moisturizer.
I recently purchased this toner and omg. I love it. Thick, creamy and so hydrating. My skin loves it. I look forward to applying this everyday.

I sm s milky toner girl , i love them snd use multiple . Thayers is ine i will NEVER go without. I will yse this forever. It goes great with my serums other toners ( i like to skin flood) snd moisturuzer . My mskeup lsys great . Highly recomend and s life long user at age 57.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Really loved this product mainly because I have extremely dry, sensitive skin and this moisturizer helped it stay fresh and moist both day and night. It never irritated my skin either, which is a HUGE plus for those of us with beauty product allergies. It is a thin, white consistency but make no mistake: it really keeps the skin looking and feeling great all day/night. I've been using it a week and have already noticed an amazing difference in the lack of dryness and itchiness I'm feeing. This is a HUGE plus for people who suffer from extremely dry and sensitive skin!!!!!

I have veryyyyy sensitive dry skin and this toner is divine. I have been using for about 3 weeks and I can tell such a difference. My skin is brighter and glassier, overall very hydrated. And there are no pore clogging ingredients! It's thick and creamy which I love. Will be perfect for summer when I prefer not to use moisturizer.
Seemed like it worked well for hydration but i had to stop using it three days in because it broke out me pretty bad big cystic acne that i don't normally get anymore.
I wish I could continue using this , i broke out so bad . It leaves your face so soft . I think my skin is just too sensitive or I'd still be using it

avis.titre: Wish it didn't break me out!!
avis.texte: This was SO hydrating and i loved it. I was so sad when i figured out it was the reason i broke out:(
I love this product so much, it is hydrating on my very dry, prone to flaking skin. It does not clog pores and lasts forever. I had mine for almost 1 year, using it 2-3 times every day.

avis.titre: I would buy this product again it is amazing,
avis.texte: I absolutely love this product, I've never like dew make up. But this goes on nicely and it keeps my face hydrated all day long, especially on my older skin, it's feels light and not sticky and has given my skin a nice glow.
An affordable product that works well. Love how this leaves my skin feeling.

This toner is so creamy, smooth, a little cold (feels so good on the face), and really affordable! It has helped some of my chronic bumps on my forehead. I think this is a great alternative to some of the more name brand, expensive products out there

I have been using this milky toner for about a month and a half now. I have very sensitive skin that gets irritated and red easily. I found this toner to be just perfect- didn't make my skin oily feeling, didn't make it feel tight, didn't sting, and moisturizing, as it claims. Up until now, most toners left my skin feeling very tight and stung when I applied it. Highly recommended
Very hydrating and moisturizing not the first time using this just a repurchase not from here but needed one asap

I bought this because of Tik Tok. I'm not a huge fan. It smells and feels like soap to me. It suds up on my face and slightly stings. I actually can't even tell you if it performs well because I can't get over feeling like I'm rubbing soap into my skin, so I usually wipe it off. I will say you get a lot of product for your money.
Used milky towers before but I love how this one is a little thicker in consistency

I would only recommed this toner if you don't have fungal acne. I honestly loved it at first but it made me break out. I havent had a fungal acne flare up in forever so i knew this was the culprit. Super upset it didnt work out for me but its a great toner if you have dry skin.

I had given up on toners but I was influenced. Hydrating, doesnt feel sticky, I use it morning snd night and my skin redness has reduced and my skin texture is better. Glad I found this to help me get through the winter months!

avis.titre: Love the texture, but broke out
avis.texte: I decided to try this toner after hearing positive reviews. I loved the texture of the product and the easiness in which to apply it, however unfortunately it made my skin break out quickly, which is highly unusual for me.
This toner has been working great for me. My skin is very dry and this is a great step before my moisturizer.

I really wanted to love this product so bad because of all the good reviews that it has. But it just didn't work for me. I have combination skin that leans towards the dryer side around my chin and mouth area. I am also very acne prone. With that said, with any product, I always make sure to look up the ingredients to make sure it isn't going to clog my pores. And I was excited to see that this product didn't have any bad ingredients! So I decided to purchase it. The consistency is super thick so it is a little harder to run into the skin. But this was not hydrating to me at all. Immediately after putting it on my skin felt tight and sticky. And I started to breakout pretty bad on my chin after just a few days of using this toner. I've since stopped using this toner and hoping my skin goes back to normal!

Maybe would make for a good face wash but make for a terrible toner foams up too much. Leaves face feeling sticky in a bad way. I think if it was advertised correctly i would have actually enjoyed it.

Maybe would make for a good face wash but make for a terrible toner foams up too much. Leaves face feeling sticky in a bad way. I think if it was advertised correctly i would have actually enjoyed it.
I wasn't sure about this at first but after using it for about a week I really love it. It's hydrating and doesn't break me out. I think it's great.

This bottle has lasted me over a year. I have only skin that is easily stripped of moisture by toners. This toner cleans and removes impurities but also hydrates and nourishes the skin. It has improved my skin texture and gives me a glassy look.

avis.titre: So good for normal/dry, sensitive & reactive skin!
avis.texte: My skin really loves this milky toner! I have fair skin that will turn bright red (especially my cheeks) the second I use the wrong product for my skin. On lazy mornings, I will swipe this toner all over my face & eyelids instead of washing and it leaves my skin feeling clean, even toned & hydrated. No fragrance, no redness or irritation. Absolutely will repurchase!

This is the only toner I've used this year, and it has really done its part in keeping my skin supple after washing. I am prone to dry patches, and this helps a lot. I even use it as a face lotion as an extra layer before moisturizing.
The perfecttttttt addition to my routine. I think it just really elevates all my other products and my skin has been looking extra smooth and moisturized since adding her in.
This is amazing. No scent, just lovely milky toner that is great for dehydrated skin. Perfect before moisturizer.

avis.titre: My holy grail for very oily, textured skin
avis.texte: I felt and saw results almost instantly. I have bumpy skin and by day 2 I felt my face was a lot smoother than it was. By day 4, it looked smoother and more hydrated. It also helped with oil production on my face over a small period of time.

avis.titre: Best toner I've ever used ( for dry, red, sensitive skin )
avis.texte: I have super dry skin with a lot of hyperpigmentation. This toner isnt stripping, its super gentle, has a good consistency. I will buy in bulk. This has helped my skin so much i do love this. Its not for everyone but its a great product with a good price from my stand point
Great product I use it at night mostly and it's creamy and I love it

I absolutely love this. I would consider it more of an essence than a straight toner with how hydrating it is, but it really is so light on the skin. It is more viscous than a toner and has this plush, pillowy feeling as you wipe it onto the skin. There's no added scent just a mild "ingredient" smell that wavers across the nose, nothing offensive. But the soothing feeling and the moisture that sinks in is cooling and wonderful. I wanted to try this since I first saw it, and finally did and the bottle is quite big justifying the price. It's gentle, wonderful hydration and allows your subsequent skincare to sink in to the skin nicely as well. I'm so happy I grabbed it.

I love thayers products usually, But this one was ok. Nothing special, when I finish the bottle i currently have I'll go back to the cucumber toner. The texture is nice but I don't like that I have to use so much at once.

Was really excited due to reading many great reviews, unfortunately my skin did not like this stuff. Used it for 2 weeks and it compromised my skin barrier, ultimately resulting in extremely dry skin (i have combo skin) around my tzone area

I'm really into asian skincare but I ran out of my go to toner and I didn't feel like waiting for a package so I got this I was very intrigued by the milky texture of this, this left my skin so plump and and glowy and layered it with my 70 aura toner.
Needed something extra in my skin routine while using tret. This does help but keep in mind it is thick. I like using more in the morning as a replacement for washing my face.
Love the mily texture and feels very light and hydrating on the skin.

avis.titre: Amazing product. I hope you never stop making this
avis.texte: I use this on my face and my forearms. I'm 60 and prone to blood bruising from years of sun damage and it's hereditary, my grandmother's skin went thing and bruised and tore in her late 50's. I bought this for my face. It lessened the red due to sun damage with in a few days AND BEST OF ALL, I put it on my forearms now and I can bang my arm hard and I never blood bruise now, it's incredible. I see you're sold-out. I need to goger more. My arms were so bad I was seriously thinking about getting arm pads to wear just to protect Mt skin but I no longer even need to consider those today. I will say once I stopped putting it on my forearms I was bruising once again, so this is now part of my daily beauty regime. If your embarrassing blood bruises on your arms a worry, please try this Thayers toner with show mushroom. I use cucumber in my face, this toner does not help the blood bruises. The snow mushroom is the bomb. My gf used on her face and her red checks lessened as well. I love both the cucumber toner and the snow mushroom.

I was using this daily for a while and loving it. I ran out and didnt use it for a while but i slathered myself in it today and even my therapist said my skin looks amazing. I forgot what a big difference this product makes on my skin

avis.titre: Immediately left my skin more hydrated
avis.texte: Love so far! Left my face and neck feeling smooth and hydrated. Quite remarkable at this price point. And I love all of the natural ingredients.

avis.titre: Hydrating milky toner- Skin care girlies!!
avis.texte: This toner is one of my favorite drugstore finds! The drugstore is still a lil behind where toners are often astringent. I use asian beauty toners/essences that focus on hydration - this is that!! Finally an affordable, unscented, drugstore hydrating toner!!! My skin was feeling really parched this winter and this along with a heavier moisturizer really saved me. My skin not only feels comfy now- but glowy and juicy. The texture is very thick btw- i use my hands and pat this on, wait a tiny bit for it to dry down (like 30 secs or so) then either add my moisturizer or another layer sometimes then moisturizer. I have really sensitive skin btw and this has never irritated it or anything. Im pretty sure there's no with hazel in this- just hydration 💧💦 Yo ulta, plz fix your reviews. There's a bunch of reviews about the face wash? I should be able to read reviews only about the toner under the toner's reviews.

Je suis très contente d'avoir reçu #freeproduct #trywithtopbox il nettoie vraiment bien en profondeur même le maquillage ne lui résiste pas, de plus il hydrate ma peau tellement bien qu'elle est beaucoup plus douce qu'auparavant! Je vais continuer de l'utiliser régulièrement.

avis.titre: It is the best. Its effect is phenomenal.
avis.texte: This is the best Toner that I've ever used. I love your products.

I don't understand the negative reviews. Product is mild and refreshing. The texture is a bit weird, so not five stars. I think Thayers makes a great variety of witch hazel products..rose, cucumber, original, AHA, mushroom...all mild and I have sensitive skin.

I thought I was getting the exfoliating toner with a different acid. When I brought this home, my daughter and sister were surprised that I would try it because it has mushrooms in it and I am freaked out by mushrooms. However, after trying this, I am amazed, and blown away at how silky smooth it makes my skin feel. I love it and I'm so glad that I got this one on accident!

avis.titre: Love it for my oily skin
avis.texte: This toner surprised me in the best way. It adds the perfeft amount of moisture to my skin without making me a greaseball. I also find that it makes my pores appear smoothed out.

avis.titre: Very sticky! but light and doesn't break me out
avis.texte: I use this before applying makeup, the stickyness and moisturizing factors does well as a base! The sticky feeling does go away after several minutes but if you can't handle tackiness I don't recommend this product.

avis.titre: Best Toner for Dry, Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: I absolutely love this toner on my dry and sensitive skin. I only use about a quarter skze amount and apply to my face and neck after I just washed. I gently massage into my skin and after a minute, my skin's soaked up the nutrients and is well hydrated.

avis.titre: it's an emulsion, not a toner
avis.texte: this is way too thick to be a toner. it's absolutely an emulsion. it sits in a blob on your cotton ball. no real hydrating effects either.

I really like to use this on nights where I have no makeup or sunscreen to wash off with a real cleanser, but rather just want the day's grime gone. It removes excess sebum from my face without feeling drying, both of which are important for me as a combination skin girly. Really loving the attention given to drier skin types in the skincare market right now! Good product. Necessary product? Probably not, but a great convenience thing to have around.

avis.titre: Overuse caused a week of flare ups😭 #Update
avis.texte: I was super excited to get this #Voxbox but my skin is NOT a fan. I used it daily for 3 days and started to break out. Went to every other day and down to twice a week. regardless I'm breaking out each time I use it. So far not a fan. going to try once a week and update again after a month. ~~~~UPDATE~~~~ Using it once a week worked out much better for me! Still a few tiny pimples around my jawline but that could also be hormones.
Make my skin worst, didn't like it. Smells like alcohol. Would not recommend. My skin is sensitive and oily. Not worth it
I really enjoyed this toner! It makes your skin feel very soft & hydrated. I am not one to use toner however this product really helps hydrate my skin & sits well on my skin.

This toner makes my skin feel and look so good! Very hydrating. I don't use a cotton ball, I pour in my hands and smooth onto my face. The cotton doesn't work well with this. Also, for those complaining that it doesn't work, try letting your face dry a bit after washing. Just damp and not soaking wet, you'll notice the difference. This is a new main staple in my routine - day and night.
This is a must product in my skincare routine. It has a creamy hydrating facial toner formula, which is gentle on the skin and leaves it soft, and hydrating!✨✨
This is a complete waste of money. Another gimmick by a company that has lost its way.

I can honestly say I'm seeing a difference in my skin. But I have a question! Is it supposed to be sticky when it dries? I don't mind because it's not my last step in my skincare. You should make it as a face primer for foundation if so, I bet that version would make it stick incredibly

avis.titre: Had hopes but this did not work
avis.texte: I have been using this toner for over two months, morning and night. I was hoping with the mushroom in it maybe it would really do what it says. At first I thought my face felt smooth and soft after applying. Some days it feels sticky. I do not see or feel the hydrating effect of this toner. Another waste of money.

The toner product is easy to apply with a cotton ball or pad but does leave your face feeling slightly sticky. I didn't notice a difference in effect over other toner products but it is very gentle on the skin

I liked the consistency. It absorped into my face prwtty quickly & was what I needed on days where I just needed a layer of hydration. I think this would be a good product for younger skin who don't need much!

The Thayers Hydrating Milky Toner helps skin feel smooth while washing away impurities. The gentle and creamy formula left my skin feeling so soft, smooth and hydrated. I like the fact that it is gentle on skin, non-drying and works for sensitive skin too. This definitely exceeded my expectations!!

At 1st I was feeling bias about the milky texture like toner should be clear!? Hahaha but once I apply it on my skin it feels like a nice prep to my skin to go with next stop of the skincare. I would definitely recommended.

I have always loved the Thayer's witch hazel, so I was very excited to try this milky toner! After using it for a few days I noticed my skin felt smoother and looked a little clearer! Id recommend this product to try.
Nothing wrong with it but also seems like an unnecessarily step to add to my skin care routine. I use a liquid exfoliator so this seems excessive

This was an interesting toner to try! It was creamier and thicker, but on skin it's really soft (which is probably where the milky part comes from). My skin felt hydrated afterwards. I don't think I needed to add any other product on top of the toner besides sunscreen because that's how soft my skin felt.
I really wanted to like this product, but at the moment I am on accutane and all it did was cause my skin to flair up. I'm sure if you ar not on accutane it would work well for you

This product was very hydrating. Though after using it for a few days (morning and night), my face started to break out very badly. I would use this toner in the morning only just for that extra hydration, but i would not use it to just clean my skin.
I was iffy about this product for a while but once I tried it out I was happy I did! My skin felt great after applying it. I will definitely be adding this into my routine.
very hydrating and really nice toner for anyone with sensitive or dry skin. It smells really soft and it's like any other thayers product. which is great.

Homestly, not supper impressed with it I really like the texture, the consistency but I did not see any improvements at all. Kind of disappointed with it, maybe it was just not for me but it works for some of you❤️✨
I really love the this toner has HA which hydrates and makes my skin so soft. I noticed some changes after about a week of using this product!
Although it was a little slimey to put on my face the first time, after a few tries I developed a technique where it wasn't overwhelming and the results were fantastic. My skin is soft and clear!
I love this Hydrating Milky Toner It leaves my skin super hydrated and soft, in addition to having a good packaging and good prevention.
Overall a really great product. The texture of the product is smooth and makes my skin feel amazing. It also does not over dry.
My face was peeling off after a bad sunburn 🥵 and this product really helped to keep my skin hydrated and made the healing process faster!
I actually love this! I wash my face, pat it dry then apply this and add moisturizer. This really helps keep my face moisturized and soft throughout the day and night!

avis.titre: A good product worth a shot
avis.texte: I like this toner but it didn't wow me. I did notice my skin feeling smoother after use, but I also feel there are so many other options that do the same. The price for this size is a good deal, though, and perfect if you're on a budget. I would not recommend this product for those that live in drier climates, as the hyaluronic acid will have an adverse effect and will actually pull moisture from your skin.
It makes my face feel very clean after using it and it helps to maintain the oiliness of my skin. I haven't noticed any drastic changes in my skin but it leaves my skin feeling nice!
I liked when using this my skin felt sooo clean. It's very hydrating for a toner too so it didn't strip my skin. I would likely buy
Love this toner so far. It goes on smooth and doesn't make me feel oily and a little goes a very long way! I feel this has def helped my complexion
I loved how it made my skin feel and look I had moisturize after but it didn't make my skin feel too dry but I do recommend it 10 out of 10

This is a great toner. Does remove all that dirt and leftover makeup my cleanser doesn't… lol! It just doesn't make my skin feel hydrated. After a min, my face feels extremely dry. I do love the scent :)
This toner is great! I use it morning and night with my skincare routine, and it leaves my skin feeling clear and hydrated.

This product ACTUALLY does what it claims. I have been searching for a toner that doesn't strip my skin — this one most definitely hydrates and leaves my skin feeling clean *and* refreshed. Recommend !!!
This toner feels great on my skin and has good ingredients don't harm my skin. However, I didn't see it help the condition of my skin at all, nor did it hurt it. It's a very neutral product

I am not much of a toner person, but this once is pretty good. I already use products with hyaluronic acid ￼in it so I'm not sure the specific affect THIS product may have had on my skin but I've been adding it to my night routine.
I like the texture of this cleanser! I have oily skin so oily cleansers don't work for me. This one was pretty good! the smell isn't bad but not fresh or fruity like I prefer but that's okay.

Absolutely love this product! I really love the spell and the packaging is really sleek. I really enjoy how my skin fell after using this product it felt really hydrating and I will definitely be adding it to my skin care routine

While not my favorite toner it gets the job done. I would recommend smelling it before purchasing because I found the sent strong. I feel like it is a good value at its price point but I will most likely go with other toners in the future. I was personally not a fan of the texture as I prefer a more jelly feeling primer. It does get the job done and I will continue to use it.
I usually don't use toners but I liked this one. It was hydrating which I need sometimes. I have combination skin so this worked well

I've used their original toned, and it dried out my skin within 3 days of use. So I was hoping this would be an improvement. The consistency is kind of slimy, so you don't need a lot. I didn't notice any differences when I added this to my skincare routine.
I've been using this toner for about a month now and I can definitely see a difference in my skin. It's very hydrating and leaves my skin feeling moisturized. I would definitely buy this again.
I liked this product because it left my skin feeling hydrated and not sticky like some other products I've tried. Overall this is a product I would buy again
This toner has been very helpful to my morning routine. I love how hydrating this toner is in comparison to other toners I've used in the past. I recommend!!

Are usually don't use a toner while doing my skin care because and I feel like it irritates my dry skin But when I tried this product on my dry skin it felt really hydrating and it didn't bother my skin or irritate my skin and it doesn't have a smell at all which is amazing.
I've never tried a hydrating milky toner before thayers, I was skeptical. But it's amazing!! The velvety soft feeling on my skin right after a clean washed face is great!
Eh. It was just okay. I haven't picked it up to use it since trying it initially. It didn't do much for hydration or skin texture.

It's interesting. The texture is definitely different than any other toner I've used. But I'm not sure I love the feeling of my skin after I use it. It's like a product with a good idea behind it but is pretty cheap

Not only do you get a lot it's actually moisturizing i had turned my bad on Thayres toners for a while since they all contained some form of witchhazel which works very bad with my skin. This however had no trace of that. Had a smooth creamy serum like texture but not sticky just moisturizing. Would definitely recommend this product
Thayers milky toner is so creamy and leaves my face nice and hydrated! I use daily after washing my face in the morning and night.

I don't have a ton of experience with using toners but I really liked this one! I applied it with a cotton ball right out of the shower to start my skincare regimen. It's alcohol free and didn't dry my face out like some toners do. I loved that it picked up any residual dirt that my cleanser missed. I would purchase in the future. There's so much product in the bottle and doesn't take a lot so I plan to enjoy this for quite a while!

I feel pretty neutral about this product. I enjoy using toners for my problem skin but my sensitive skin doesn't always react positively to this product. Id say it's worth a try for the price range but there are better toners out there.
